units.source_text: 末摘花想起连侍从都要离开她，心中甚是懊恼，又觉十分可惜。

en.t: Safflower thought that even Jijū was going to leave her, and she felt deeply distressed and terribly sorry.

units.source_text: 然而无法挽留，惟有扬声号哭。

en.t: Yet she had no way to keep her there, and could only raise her voice and weep aloud.

units.source_text: 想送她一件衣裳作纪念物，然而衣裳都是污旧的，拿不出去。

en.t: She wanted to give her a robe as a keepsake, but all the robes were soiled and old, and could not be offered.

units.source_text: 总想送她一点东西，以报长年服务之劳，然而无物可送。

en.t: She kept wanting to give her something, to repay her many years of service, but there was nothing she could give.

units.source_text: 她头上掉下来的头发，一直攒在一起，理成一束发绺，长达九尺以上，非常美观。

en.t: The hair that had fallen from her head had long been gathered and arranged into a single lock, more than nine feet long and very beautiful.

units.source_text: 就把它装在一只精致的盒子里，送给侍从作为纪念物。

en.t: So she placed it in a delicate box and gave it to Jijū as a keepsake.

units.source_text: 此外又添加一瓶薰衣香，是家中旧藏之物，香气非常浓烈。

en.t: In addition, she added a jar of incense for perfuming clothes, an old household treasure with an extremely strong fragrance.
There were also parting words of farewell:
